aggregation_convention: All attempted starts enter failure denominators; geometry distributions include finite nonconverged starts; selected-seed distributions use the selected start. Exact geometry uses raw canonical/surveyed errors; noisy geometry uses proper planar rigid aligned joint errors. Acceptance thresholds are disclosed heuristics, independent of rank, and do not establish uniqueness. Solution groups are per identical-data cell, proper planar rigid aligned, RMS over all xyz coordinates; no cross-seed grouping.

diagnostics.ambiguity: Full measurement rank is local only; finite multistart exploration does not prove global uniqueness
diagnostics.solution_grouping: Proper planar rigid aligned geometry RMS; no scale or reflections

truth_jacobian.interpretation: Local measurement rank only; full rank does not prove global uniqueness
truth_jacobian.scaling: J of normalized range residuals with respect to theta / parameter_scale_m; all parameters in metres

experiment.coordinate_convention: Right-handed Cartesian frame in metres. The planar tag trajectory is z=0. For the informative map, beacon b0=(0,0,h), b1=(d,0,h), b2 has positive y, and all four beacons share height h>0. Beacon IDs are zero-based.

alignment.description: Map-only least-squares planar proper rigid alignment; no scale, reflection, z translation, or 3D tilt

pairing.default_variants: Same estimator and starts, differing only in evaluation budget
pairing.initialization: truth_near is diagnostic; initial_error_m is Gaussian parameter SD, with constrained positive coordinates clipped at twice the solver floor (2e-6 m)
pairing.map_constraint: Known-map mode fixes the synthetic surveyed truth map and projects only beacon starts onto it; joint mode fits its map
pairing.noise: Same seed reuses standard-normal draws across noise levels; sample-count levels have different grids
pairing.scope: Identical observations and trajectory starts within each value/seed cell
